summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Quantum eMotion Corp., a foreign private issuer, to report the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 18, 2026. The meeting covered standard matters: election of directors, reappointment of auditors, and approval of stock option plan amendments. The filing also includes a general business update on strategic progress, such as uplisting to NYSE American and product developments, but does not announce any specific special-situation event like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. It is a periodic report, not a triggering event.
